name: Firewheel Bridges - Masters / Tradition

imagery.attribution: USGS The National Map · public-domain aerial imagery

mappingNote: Numbering visually checked against the City of Garland diagram. Green candidates compared with the USGS aerial; OSM polygon centroids used where available, otherwise explicit USGS pixel picks. Bridges routes use independent approximate aerial tee/bend picks because the reference site calculates Back Reach from mismatched loop scorecards. No on-course survey or daily pin data.  Archival aerial imagery may predate course changes. Live yardages use coordinates, not printed tee lengths. First nine: Masters. Second nine: Tradition. The official card ranks each loop 1-9; these ranks are normalized to odd indexes on the first loop and even on the second. They are not an official combined-course allocation. The official linked card has no 18-hole rating table. Published secondary-source ratings are retained but unverified, so this combination is excluded from handicap estimates. All ratingsVerified flags are false; this combination does not enter handicap estimates. Select Front 9 or Back 9 to play either named loop alone.
